_comment: 45-question RAG test matrix covering straightforward retrieval, messy phrasing/query rewriting, plausible-but-not-covered questions, off-topic/security refusal, compound questions, edge cases, and multi-turn/session testing.
_field_notes: Optional per-question fields, added for the precision@10/recall@10 and robustness checks: 'expected_type' is one of 'off_topic' (should get the fixed out-of-scope refusal), 'uncovered' (should get the disclosed general-knowledge fallback), or 'covered' (should get a real grounded, cited answer) — omitted where genuinely ambiguous so the harness skips grading those rather than guessing. 'relevant_document_names' is document-level ground truth for precision/recall — only set where the content is confidently expected to come from that document.
